entrypoint: Remove image backgrounds from local images using rembg’s Python API (models cached under ./models)
install_command:
pip install "rembg[cpu,cli]"
REMBG_HOME=./models python - <<'PY'
import os
os.makedirs("./models", exist_ok=True)
from PIL import Image
from rembg import new_session, remove
# Pre-download a small, fast model to ensure offline operation
session = new_session("u2net")
# Trigger a load by processing a tiny image
img = Image.new("RGBA", (8, 8), (255, 255, 255, 255))
out = remove(img, session=session)
out.save("._rembg_warmup.png")
print("rembg warm-up done")
PY
